name: readme-reviewer
description: Review any GitHub README for how well it is WRITTEN. The primary judgment is an LLM craft review across four dimensions — first-screen positioning, shortest runnable path, writing quality, and honest limits; a deterministic lint runs first as a hygiene/security filter and its output is explicitly not a quality verdict. Shape-aware: library, CLI, app, research, awesome list, monorepo and template READMEs get different exemptions. Evidence is triangulation (public specs + qualitative patterns), NOT a star gradient.
